reviewed_static_guards.fact: Caller debug/breakaway flags rejected; finite allowed executable/module pin sets; process budget1..2048; helper itself selects DEBUG_PROCESS.

CREATE_PROCESS/LOAD_DLL must supply a real file handle; held duplicate is hashed under deadline and retained for final hash; module allowlist and primary/child executable image allowlist checked; event hFile closed in finally.

Per-generation actual PID/creation FILETIME/held process handle/Job membership captured; unknown generation/RIP/unsupported events fail; first loader breakpoint assumption is explicit; other exceptions are passed as not handled; received event always continued.
Primary wait/exit plus Job active and total process accounting used; max16 concurrent and finite total cap. No reliance on DEBUG_ONLY_THIS_PROCESS for descendant coverage.
Own suspended process is assigned to exclusive kill-on-close Job before resume; all debug children must be observed in that Job.

Timeout/error terminates only the owned Job (or own never-resumed primary if assignment failed), observes cleanup5s, rehashes held modules with separate25s budget, independently compares each process exit with exit event/continuation, checks create/exit/TotalProcesses equality, closes owned handles.

required_before_execution_conditions: The Git launcher path is cmd/git.exe, but Git calls pass allowed_images=[git] only while allowing up to4 processes. Root must establish a finite actual launcher/descendant executable set (including any Git-for-Windows shim target) and wire it into allowed_images; runtime module membership alone cannot authorize another CREATE_PROCESS image. This review did not execute Git/debugger to discover that set.
Root must freeze actual Python/OS/Git/GoTool images and complete GOROOT/module-cache membership before grant; these inputs are intentionally absent, not proven by old Go3 evidence.

Fixed2048/16 process budgets,131072 events/32768 modules,256MiB per module/128GiB aggregate and cleanup5/finalization25/outer15000 are proposed caps requiring explicit Root scope. File hashing checks deadlines between reads; it does not bound a blocking kernel read. Outer owned Job is the separate hard wall bound.
Observe actual nested Job membership, breakpoint/child event flow and cleanup in finite authorized execution. No behavioral PASS or full lifetime Python attestation is supplied by AST.
